description:
Finding a beacon in the enterprise: locators for DNS names, SRV and DNS-SD
    record sets, a TXT parameter under the network's domain, a well-known HTTPS
    beacon document, and Kubernetes services; the beacon document itself; and
    the Spring Boot and Micronaut wiring that binds agentspaces.bootstrap.* and
    composes each group's bootstrap chain. A standalone project on the published
    AgentSpaces libraries, JDK-only beyond them.
